title: Building a Learning Organization
before: Leaders shape culture through the systems they build: how decisions are made, who hears about problems and what gets reviewed after something goes wrong.

turns.text: Every division learns something every day. The question is whether that learning reaches the people who make decisions. In this course, you'll look at the systems you lead and how they carry, or block, what your people know.

guidance.text: When information can only travel up, it often doesn't. Look for the places where it stops.
Think of the last time something went wrong. Was there a review, and who was in the room?
Your reaction to bad news is a system, too. People learn it fast.
